description: Delete a traffic policy rule list in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A rule list used by a traffic policy is refused as in use; delete the policy first. The rules it holds are not deleted. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the traffic policy rule list.

name: policy_traffic_rule_list_delete
